messages.subject: Rebound Body Studio — the site is now 14 pages, and I need five codes from you
messages.body:
Hi Randi,

Please disregard my last note - I have since gone through your official
MassageBook profile properly and rebuilt the site around what is actually
there.

Here is where it stands, now fourteen pages rather than one:
https://azwebcorp.com/preview/rebound/

It uses your own logo and your teal and yellow throughout. Every service
has its own page - therapeutic, sports, prenatal, deep core, stretch and
corrective exercise - with all your durations and prices, both 3-packs, a
deals page, a studio page for the three of you, and a page explaining what
massage actually does to muscle and connective tissue. The address is set
to 1138 N. Higley Rd, Suite 109. Screenshots below.

Worth checking the prices and how I have described Brian and Wendy, since
I read all of that off your booking pages rather than from you.

THE FIVE CODES THAT SWITCH YOUR CALENDAR ON

Your booking calendar is the one thing I genuinely cannot build myself,
and it is worth explaining why rather than just asking.

MassageBook ties the booking widget to your account, and your public pages
are deliberately set to refuse being displayed inside another website. I
checked this properly rather than assuming it. So there is no version of
this where I can wire up your live availability from the outside - the
code has to come from inside your account.

In the meantime the booking page carries a real calendar built from your
opening hours: it shows which days you work and until when,
